reference_sql:
WITH report AS (
  -- one row per month and promotion type: the report as it would go out ('none' for a line with no promotion)
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS month, COALESCE(p.promo_type, 'none') AS promo_type,
    SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS revenue
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  LEFT JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = l.promo_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_ts), COALESCE(p.promo_type, 'none')
), report_months AS (
  -- one row per month: the report's total over every promotion type
  SELECT month, SUM(revenue) AS report_revenue
  FROM report
  GROUP BY month
), sales_months AS (
  -- one row per month: revenue in sales (order_month is the UTC month)
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS sales_revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_month BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-06-01'
  GROUP BY order_month
)
SELECT r.month, r.report_revenue, s.sales_revenue,
  r.report_revenue - s.sales_revenue AS difference
FROM report_months r
JOIN sales_months s ON s.month = r.month

WITH report AS (
  -- one row per month and promotion type: the report as it would go out ('none' for a line with no promotion)
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS month, COALESCE(p.promo_type, 'none') AS promo_type,
    SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS revenue
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  LEFT JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = l.promo_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_ts), COALESCE(p.promo_type, 'none')
), both_sides AS (
  -- one row per report row or sales line, with its month, its revenue and its side
  SELECT month, revenue, 'report' AS side
  FROM report
  UNION ALL
  SELECT order_month, net_revenue_eur, 'sales'
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_month BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-06-01'
)
SELECT month,
  SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE side = 'report') AS report_revenue,
  SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE side = 'sales') AS sales_revenue,
  SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE side = 'report') - SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE side = 'sales') AS difference
FROM both_sides
GROUP BY month

solver.query:
WITH ls AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS DATE) AS month, ol.promo_id,
    ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS rev
  FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
), report AS (
  SELECT ls.month, COALESCE(p.promo_type, 'none') AS promo_type, SUM(ls.rev) AS revenue
  FROM ls LEFT JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = ls.promo_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), r AS (
  SELECT month, SUM(revenue) AS report_revenue FROM report GROUP BY month
), s AS (
  SELECT CAST(order_month AS DATE) AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS sales_revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE CAST(order_month AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-06-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT r.month, r.report_revenue, s.sales_revenue, r.report_revenue - s.sales_revenue AS difference
FROM r LEFT JOIN s ON s.month = r.month
